scope: Free coverage source feasibility. No native application has been implemented.

user_direction.platform: Native macOS first, fitting the latest macOS
user_direction.centerpiece: Live race coverage when free access is available
user_direction.video: Explore free video as well as data
user_direction.workflow: RVA workflow retired by user instruction

live_data.status: Unauthenticated negotiation and subscription snapshot verified
limits: Undocumented application feed without a published availability guarantee
A completed-session snapshot does not prove changing live race data
Individual topic and field availability must be detected
Do not promise free live telemetry or moving-car coordinates

replay.coverage: Historical sessions from 2023 onward, subject to actual dataset availability
replay.availability: Published live window lasts from 30 minutes before a session through 30 minutes after it; historical access is free outside it. Check actual data readiness.
notes: Replay means reconstructing the session from historical data, not a full race video archive
Keep discrete timing state separate from interpolated visual movement
Use timing position events for the leaderboard, not inferred map order
Cache historical downloads locally and preserve raw timestamps
Missing measurements remain unavailable rather than becoming zero
Some session dates or times may be absent

video.approach: Official viewing links initially; validate any in-app embedded player individually

official_free_offerings.coverage: Every practice session and selected race weekends without a subscription
The Fast Lane creator altcasts announced for Miami, Austin, and Las Vegas in 2026
Selected live Grands Prix, delayed replay coverage for others
British GP live and other-session highlights under announced rights through 2026

limits: Free viewing does not establish a third-party playback API or redistribution permission
No actual video playback or embedding was tested
Highlights and creator altcasts are distinct from complete world-feed race coverage

excluded_paid_live_provider.reason: Current live REST, MQTT, and WebSocket access requires a paid sponsor tier

direct_probes.interpretation: Obsolete protocol endpoint; does not determine current Core feed availability
Preflight used by one library is not necessary for the successful standard Core POST

direct_probes.target: F1 Core JSON handshake and Subscribe over LongPolling
direct_probes.interpretation: Successful unauthenticated subscription returning useful topic snapshots; not an active-race streaming validation
direct_probes.metadata_caution: Returned meeting geography/name fields were inconsistent and the Finalised status accompanied an upcoming session date. Do not treat this snapshot as current live truth without cross-checking.

direct_probes.interpretation: Archive access works but index completeness is not established
Returned calendar is accessible; upcoming event accuracy needs normal cross-checking
Historical lap and sector data received, with some null measurements
Position is a change-event series, not a continuous frame stream
Historical timestamped x/y/z samples received; full-session replay processing remains untested

next_validation: Verify fresh, changing timing and race-control events during an active session
Compare session identity and timing with the calendar and authoritative race context
Measure freshness, reconnect reconciliation, and topic availability over a session
Build live and replay adapters into the same native session model
